verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's first-party docs describe workflows that send customized meeting-lifecycle messages with configurable timing and content, explicitly aimed at minimizing no-shows and increasing attendance. Workflows can attach to links (including automatically to every new link), personalize messages with guest data and a reschedule link, follow the meeting when it is rescheduled, stop when it is cancelled, and send reminders from your own email address. The core story is delivered, but the evidence is vendor-only. Missing for 10: any evidence of SMS reminders, explicit documentation of post-meeting follow-up messages (only 'before or after' timing for webhook actions is shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration that reminders reduce no-shows.
